couple:garba-01.notes: REF-C1 match: rani pink lehenga + white embroidered bandeau + gota-border pink dupatta with tassels; he in white kurta pyjama with red phulkari dupatta over both shoulders; mirror selfie with phone over face, hand on cheek, his arm at her waist; store fitting area with racks + fluorescent light. Both read ~20. Real faces, no mannequin.

couple:garba-03.notes: REF-C3 match: ivory mirror-work lehenga + embellished sleeveless blouse + sheer dupatta; he in white kurta with blue denim; seated on stone steps with carved pillar and diyas, golden hour; she holds phone, leaning in. Minor: kurta reads plain white rather than chikankari; acceptable.
